items.title: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: It is the seventh arrest in connection to the incident near RAF Fairford last month.

items.title: Police make further arrest over RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: Counter terror police have made a seventh arrest in connection with an incident which took place close to RAF Fairford on 27 September.

items.title: I'd rather have another election than do a deal with Reform UK, says Badenoch
items.summary: The Conservative Party leader also pledged to cut the cost of hiring 21 to 24 year olds.

items.title: Forensics student admits 'Dexter-style' murder in 'kill room'
items.summary: A forensics student who was obsessed with US TV drama Dexter has pleaded guilty to murdering a sex worker in a "kill room" set up inside an Airbnb.

items.title: Rise in babies in care proceedings raises fears of unnecessary adoptions, experts tell BBC
items.summary: With better support, many babies may not have needed to go into care, File on 4 Investigates is told.

items.title: PCs sacked after 92-year-old tasered and pepper sprayed in care home
items.summary: Two officers have been sacked for gross misconduct after using a Taser and pepper spray on a 92-year-old amputee, the police watchdog has said.
